bio: Inglewood Manor is a preserved Edwardian manor house in the idyllic Cheshire countryside. The Grade II listed building has stunning interiors and manicured grounds, providing an elegant setting for a traditional Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Executive Suite and Burton Suite, providing garden views. The Afternoon Tea menu features a range of freshly made sandwiches, homemade scones with jam and clotted cream and a selection of cakes and pastries.  Inglewood Manor is located close to Chester and an ideal Afternoon Tea destination for those visiting local attractions such as Chester Zoo, Cheshire Oaks and the Blue Planet Aquarium.
